subject.title: feat(dashboard): workspace document + control plane (plugin backend) [1/3]

question: Should OpenClaw accept a default-enabled bundled dashboard control-plane plugin after the storage, undo, and actor-provenance blockers are fixed, or should this remain opt-in/external for now?
rationale: The PR adds an always-on product surface with mutating gateway RPCs/tools, persistent state, approval/provenance semantics, and dependency graph changes, so automation cannot choose the product and security boundary safely.

options.title: Harden And Keep Bundled
options.body: Keep the PR open and require SQLite-backed or approved artifact state, monotonic undo, trusted actor derivation, exact-head dependency authorization, and explicit security/product approval before merge.

options.title: Make It Opt-In Or External
options.body: Require the dashboard foundation to ship off by default or outside the bundled core plugin set until the default-on boundary is sponsored.

options.title: Pause The Dashboard Stack
options.body: Pause or close this stack if maintainers do not want a bundled dashboard product surface in the current roadmap window.

recommendation.title: Harden And Keep Bundled
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open and require SQLite-backed or approved artifact state, monotonic undo, trusted actor derivation, exact-head dependency authorization, and explicit security/product approval before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the closest recent bundled plugin plus Control UI tab precedent and appears best positioned to decide whether this dashboard belongs in the same product lane.
